enabled.label: Run the scheduled background jobs
enabled.help: The worker runs the stock pull, the cart-hold clean-up, the ERP documents and the stock check on their own timetable. Off stops every scheduled job; jobs already queued still finish.

tickSeconds.label: Look at the timetable every (seconds)
tickSeconds.help: How often the scheduling worker checks which job is due and which ERP message is waiting.

lockSeconds.label: Scheduler lock (seconds)
lockSeconds.help: Only one worker plans the jobs. It renews its lock well before this time runs out; if that worker stops, another one takes over after this many seconds.

everySeconds.label: Worker says it is alive every (seconds)
everySeconds.help: Each worker writes a heartbeat this often; the Server page shows the newest one.

staleSeconds.label: Call the worker stale after (seconds)
staleSeconds.help: When the newest heartbeat is older than this, the Server page warns that the worker is not answering.

concurrency.label: Jobs at the same time (per worker)
concurrency.help: How many jobs one worker runs at once.

lockSeconds.label: Job lock (seconds)
lockSeconds.help: A running job keeps its lock while its worker is alive. If the worker stops in the middle of a job, another worker runs it again after this many seconds; nothing is done twice.

maxAttempts.label: Tries per job
maxAttempts.help: A failing job is tried this many times in all; after the last try it is listed as failed for good (dead letter) on the Server page.

backoffBaseSeconds.label: First wait before trying again (seconds)
backoffBaseSeconds.help: The wait doubles after each failed try.

backoffMaxSeconds.label: Longest wait before trying again (seconds)
backoffMaxSeconds.help: The doubling wait never goes above this.

keepCompleted.label: Finished jobs kept in the queue
keepCompleted.help: How many finished jobs the queue store keeps for checking. Every run is also in the job history (JobRun), which is never deleted.

keepFailed.label: Failed jobs kept in the queue
keepFailed.help: How many failed jobs the queue store keeps. Every failure is also in the job history with its reason.

failedHours.label: Failed jobs shown from the last (hours)
failedHours.help: The Server page lists failed jobs from this many hours back. A job that succeeded on a later try is not listed.
